Corporate Governance · December 3, 2025

Makamin Saudi Holding Issues Second Notice Calling for Shareholder Information Updates and Enhanced Governance Compliance

Makamin Saudi Holding Company for Oil & Gas Services has issued its second notice to shareholders, emphasizing the urgent need to complete updates to their personal and ownership information as part of the Company's ongoing efforts to strengthen corporate governance, improve record accuracy, and maintain reliable information for shareholder-related procedures.

The notice follows Board Resolution No. (8/2025), concerning the activation and updating of the Shareholder Register, and Board Resolution No. (9/2025), addressing governance requirements and formal verification procedures. It also builds on the Company's shareholder information update initiative launched on July 21, 2025, through a dedicated online portal.

No Complete Updates Received as of the Notice Date

As of the issuance of this notice on December 3, 2025, the Company had not received any complete shareholder information updates meeting the applicable regulatory requirements through the designated online portal. Shareholders were therefore urged to promptly complete their updates and submit the required supporting documentation.

The Company emphasizes that continued reliance on outdated shareholder records does not align with corporate governance and compliance requirements, particularly in light of observable discrepancies in certain ownership and attendance records. These circumstances require urgent completion of the information update and formal verification procedures.

Strengthening Shareholder Record Integrity

The Company emphasizes that updating shareholder information is a necessary obligation to maintain reliable corporate records and verify shareholder information against approved legal documentation, supporting transparency and the integrity of voting and representation procedures.

The initiative focuses on:

  • Updating and verifying shareholder information for accuracy and completeness.
  • Strengthening the reliability of the Shareholder Register and related procedures.
  • Supporting compliance with corporate governance and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Protecting lawful shareholder rights through clear verification procedures.

Protecting Shareholder Rights and Ensuring Compliance

The Company clarifies that the information update process is intended to review and validate shareholder records and address potential discrepancies without prejudice to established rights supported by legally recognized documentation.

No amendment or ownership claim shall be accepted in the Shareholder Register unless the required formal verification and review procedures have been completed in accordance with the Company's Articles of Association and applicable regulations.

Urgent Call for Shareholders to Complete Their Updates

Makamin Saudi Holding urges all shareholders to promptly complete the information update process and submit the required information and supporting documentation through the designated online portal:

https://www.makamin.com.sa/update-shareholder

For inquiries and assistance:

report@makamin.com.sa

info@makamin.com.sa

The Company emphasizes that completing shareholder information updates is the direct responsibility of each shareholder. Compliance with these procedures supports reliable corporate records, stronger governance practices, and the continued protection of lawful shareholder rights and the interests of both the Company and its shareholders.
